name: Nashville
tagline: Music City's honky-tonks and hot chicken
summary: Nashville is the capital of country music. Hear live bands at all hours on Broadway's honky-tonks, see a show at the Grand Ole Opry or the Ryman, tour the Country Music Hall of Fame and eat fiery hot chicken.
seasonNote: Spring and autumn are mild. June brings CMA Fest; summers are hot and humid.
arrival: Nashville International Airport is 15 minutes from downtown.
cashTip: Cards and tap work almost everywhere. Tip 18-22% at restaurants and a dollar or two per drink at bars.
foodTip: Nashville hot chicken, meat-and-three and biscuits.
